work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXVII (address LF37554–37556 to Luka Costan, Observant Franciscan) appoints him apostolic visitor of the Bosnian Franciscan province in Ottoman territory; LF37615 → LF37622 across own provenance LF37618 and page number 256 LF37621; complete 24 April 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF37561–37561; the source closing at LF37647–37650 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quarta aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octayo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
